run.name: Biomarin Pharmaceutical Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (BMRN)
run.summary: BioMarin is a profitable, cash-generative rare-disease company that took on USD 4,235 million of debt for Amicus. Liquidity is adequate, but leverage on filed earnings is high and the true run-rate is unproven. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is BIOMARIN PHARMACEUTICAL INC.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. LTM = FY2025 + 9M 2026 - 9M 2025; EBITDA 378,821 thousand USD. Debt 4,235,000 (Q3 10-Q page:22); cash 736,007 (page:8); net debt 3,498,993. Amicus in earnings from 2026-04-27 only, and no pro forma EBITDA is supplied. Adding back impairment 137,248, write-off 119,208 and acquired IPR&D 287,685 (analyst-derived, not a company measure) gives EBITDA 922,962, 4.59x and 3.79x. The covenant ratio is defined differently and is not printed

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 378,821 divided by LTM cash interest 69,721 = 7,245 + 66,048 - 3,572 (Q3 10-Q page:10). Not a run-rate: accrued interest of 37,480 was unpaid at 2026-09-30 (page:20) and Amicus is in EBITDA from 2026-04-27 only. Annualised Q3 coupon interest of 210,732 gives 1.80x on this EBITDA and 4.38x on the 922,962 adjusted EBITDA (analyst-derived)

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 736,007 thousand (Q3 10-Q page:8), no investments held (page:45). Undrawn 600.0 million of the 2026 Revolving Facility, matures April 2031 (page:25, page:48), subject to compliance with the credit agreement. Total 1,336.0 million. No letters of credit drawn on the revolver are stated; the 10-K notes standby letters of credit secured by restricted investments, amount not supplied (10-K page:202)

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No combined earnings base, covenant ratios, executed legal documents or ratings are supplied, so leverage and covenant headroom cannot be pinned down.
CP-1 main limitation: No combined earnings base, covenant ratios or legal documents are supplied, so true run-rate leverage and covenant headroom cannot be measured.
